notes: The prompt self-declares a third-person action roguelike and the moment-to-moment game is dodge-rolling through combat rooms with melee and ranged weapons, so Action leads; RPG is named second for the run economy the shop rooms, echo-shard currency, runes and weapon upgrades add, which is where social-hub comes from. Shape is rooms-sequence, Action's chain of discrete combat rooms joined by corridors, which is what a floor of 6-10 compact randomly arranged rooms actually is - I rejected world-chaptered because the author asked for one unified temple style that only darkens with depth and the floors are procedurally regenerated per run rather than five authored maps, and rejected world-underground because there is no surface map above and nothing overhangs. That keeps the build on P0 rather than an unshippable P4, and the note for the pipeline is that the same room-chain is generated five times with a darkening blue-violet palette and a visible stone stair or lift between floors. Kept Hack & Slash's arena-lockin for combat rooms that seal until cleared and spawner-npc for the mobs and elites, dropped destructible-cluster since nothing breakable was described; with no user to ask I treated the treasure and rest rooms as room types of the same chain, which no option covers, and the three-phase boss as the last room rather than a separate arena.
